activity.role: Commander of French Groupe d'armées du Centre
activity.notes: Took command of Centre army group on 2 May 1916. Later chief of general staff dated April 28, 1917 and formal commander-in-chief May 15. The 4 May handover date is a secondary group chronology and overlaps the staff appointment; transition not a fabricated exclusive linear career; 4 May boundary approximate pending exact preflight sources. Activity domain emphasis: military.

sources.title: L'histoire en rafale — 2 mai 1916: Pétain and Groupe d'armées du Centre
sources.citation_text: Published transcript discussion of Poincaré's memoir records Pétain replacing Langle de Cary as Centre army group commander and Nivelle taking Verdun army command on 2 May 1916.

sources.title: Larousse — Pétain, Dictionnaire de l'histoire de France
sources.citation_text: Larousse places his 2 May 1916 promotion to commander of Centre army group and May 15 1917 elevation to French commander in chief.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1926 supplement — Pétain
sources.citation_text: Period source records Pétain becoming general chief of staff at War Ministry on 28 April 1917 and succeeding Nivelle as field commander in chief on May 15.
